prompt: Wire up cloud federation: grant the OIDC permission and take the role from storage.
explanation: Federation needs exactly two things in the workflow: `id-token: write` so the job can mint OIDC tokens, and the cloud role to assume — stored as a secret and read through `${{ secrets.… }}`. The cloud side trusts the issuer; no keys ever change hands.
template:
name: Deploy to AWS
on: push
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: ___
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ ___ }}
          aws-region: us-east-1
